scale_reference.note: The OBJ X-span registers to the floor-plan width (1150 px). m_per_px is the QGIS-GCP calibration carried over from SIM/manifest.json. voxelize.py computes m_per_unit = (floorplan_w_px * m_per_px) / obj_x_span_units. This supersedes the 'units are inches' note in viewer3d.js (that would make the ceiling ~4 m; the QGIS scale gives a realistic ~2.85 m).

_computed_by_voxelize: grid_shape, cell_size_m, m_per_unit, origin_units, ceiling_height_m are filled in by voxelize.py

obj_material_map.comment: Steel_Brushed_Stainless -> core (highest-loss existing class; stand-in for metal)
Ty_* palette (incl. Ty_Skin) -> furniture / people clutter
default: FrontColor bulk walls + anything unmatched -> drywall partition

_priority_note: low -> high; when triangles of different classes land in the same voxel, the higher-priority class wins (core > concrete > drywall > glass > furniture > air).

physics.crossing_loss_source: physics_3d.CrossingLUT (physics_v2 Blocks A/B): per-crossing angle+thickness Fresnel/Airy transmission + Im(q) bulk absorption. NOT the flat materials[].loss_db table.
physics.arrival_time: 3-D eikonal fast-march (scikit-fmm) on slowness Re(sqrt(eps_r))/c with barrier classes masked; refraction (bending/lag) and corner wraparound emerge from the single solve. NOT geometric d/c.
physics.note: engine_3d.py SceneV3: PL(x,y,z) = Motley-Keenan spreading [fspl_1m(f) + 10*n_exp*log10(max(d,d0))] + Sigma per-crossing slab loss from the CrossingLUT (real Fresnel/Airy + absorption). T(x,y,z) = 3-D eikonal (skfmm). n_exp/d0_m/fspl_const_db are read by SceneV3; the flat obstruction_*/satObs params and the materials[].loss_db table are NOT used by the engine -- they are the browser display + in-browser analytic-fallback model (Frontend/simulator/simulation3d.js, Frontend/landing/landing.js preprocess). DEFERRED to later stages (power-summed onto the direct field): 3-D UTD diffraction (S8), reflection/scattering modules, correlated shadow field (S11).

fallback_obstruction_db.note: flat-dB saturation stand-in from the old v1 model; used only by the browser analytic fallback, not by SceneV3.

tx.note: default transmitter height as a fraction of interior ceiling height (ceiling-mounted AP).
